entry.title: [BIP Proposal] Transport Feature Negotiation
entry.summary:
A draft Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) has been prepared and is now available for review. The proposal, along with a pull request, can be accessed at [this GitHub link](https://github.com/liamgilligan/bips/pull/1). Several decisions regarding previously unresolved questions have been incorporated into the current draft.
Feedback from the community is encouraged to refine and improve the proposal. Input from a range of perspectives will help ensure that the proposed changes are robust and beneficial for the broader ecosystem. Those interested in contributing or reviewing are invited to examine the draft and provide their comments through the linked platform.
